title: internal/cli tests claim runs without redirecting TICFAC_REGISTRY_DIR, writing test registrations into the operator's real ~/.ticfac/registry
body: internal/cli's status tests call runlife.Claim for run ids like r-status and r-sigterm from per-test temp checkouts but never redirect the registry directory, so every gate and CI run leaves registrations in the operator's real ~/.ticfac/registry pointing at deleted temp dirs (verified: r-status.json, r-1.json, r-sigterm.json present after the gate run). runlife's own TestMain redirects the registry for exactly this reason ('a test that claims a run must not write on the machine that runs it'); aj9's registration made cli claims writes, and 9oo's refusal now makes those stray registrations load-bearing for cli test claims. A package TestMain redirecting runregistry.RegistryDirEnv in internal/cli fixes it.
